episodes.title: The New Threat
episodes.summary: Mini Goku is Just Precious! I'm Gohan With no new battles to fight, Goku has been living a quiet life in the countryside with his wife Chi-chi and their son Gohan! While Goku makes plans to spend a happy day with friends on Master Roshi's island, a powerful new threat is on its way to Earth. And the arrival of this sinister alien could spell disaster for Goku and his friends!

episodes.title: Reunions
episodes.summary: The Strongest Warrior in All of History is Goku's Brother! Goku and Gohan attend a reunion on Master Roshi's island, where Goku introduces his son to all of his old friends. The smiles quickly fade, however, as an unexpected visitor lands on the island, and for Goku the day becomes a reunion of a different kind. A powerful alien has arrived. It's Raditz, Goku's evil older brother!

episodes.title: Unlikely Alliance
episodes.summary: Alright! This is the Strongest Combo on Earth! Raditz has kidnapped Gohan! And unless Goku agrees to forsake his friends and the people of Earth by joining the sinister Saiyan, he may never see his son again! All hope is not lost, however, as a second uninvited guest arrives on the island and Goku forges an unlikely alliance!

episodes.title: Piccolo's Plan
episodes.summary: Piccolo's Trump Card! Gohan is a Crybaby The situation looks bleak for Goku and Piccolo, as Raditz easily deflects every attack they send his way. But Piccolo may have a way to stop the sinister Saiyan. He's perfected a powerful new attack... the Special Beam Cannon! There's only one problem. Piccolo needs time to gather the energy for the blast, which means Goku will have to last for five minutes against Raditz alone!

episodes.title: Gohan's Rage
episodes.summary: Goku Dies! There's Only One Chance Left As Goku takes blow after punishing blow from the evil Raditz, Gohan is able to watch no longer! The young boy's rage unlocks an awesome power sleeping within him, and he unleashes a mighty attack that not even Radtiz can resist! But as quickly as Gohan's power appears, it vanishes. And when Raditz prepares to strike back, Goku must make the ultimate sacrifice to save his son!

episodes.title: No Time Like the Present
episodes.summary: Even Enma-sama is Surprised — A Fight in the Afterlife With Raditz defeated and Goku gone from this world, the surviving Z-Fighters must begin preparing for the arrival of two more Saiyans who will reach Earth in one year's time. Piccolo takes Gohan into the wild for a severe training program, in the hope that his hidden power will be revealed. Meanwhile, Goku embarks on a new adventure in the next world, as he must travel the endless miles of Snake Way to receive training from the legendary King Kai!

episodes.title: Day 1
episodes.summary: Dinosaur Survival! Gohan's Difficult Training Gohan begins his first day of Piccolo's training. Alone in the wilderness, he must quickly learn to take care of himself. But that isn't easy when he's tired, hungry -- and being chased by hungry dinosaurs! If Gohan's first day is this dangerous, how will he ever survive for the second?

episodes.title: Gohan Goes Bananas!
episodes.summary: The Great Transformation on a Moonlit Night! The Secret of Gohan's Power Krillin receives a startling message. Korin wants him to gather Yamcha, Tien, and Chiaotzu and report for special training! And if that weren't enough, he and Roshi still have to find a way to tell Chichi what's happened to Goku and her son. Meanwhile, Gohan's training causes him to undergo a shocking transformation!

episodes.title: The Strangest Robot
episodes.summary: Sorry Robot-san — The Tears that Vanished in the Desert Gohan falls into a hole in the desert and discovers a robot buried in sand in an ancient underground ruin. The robot tells him not to disturb its sleep, but Gohan, reluctantly, wakes it up again and again. As the robot looks after Gohan, it begins to get along with him.

episodes.title: A New Friend
episodes.summary: Don't Cry Gohan! His First Fight Krillin visits Yamcha in preparation for the crisis one year from now. Yamcha, who had left martial arts to become a professional baseball player, decides to train under Kami after learning of Goku's death and the Saiyan invasion. Meanwhile, Gohan, who has been surviving in the wilderness, begins caring for an injured herbivorous dinosaur.

episodes.title: Terror on Arlia
episodes.summary: The Saiyan, Strongest Warriors in the Universe, Awaken! Vegeta and Nappa, two Saiyans heading to Earth, plan to plunder Planet Arlia on the way. However, the once fertile planet Arlia has become a ruined planet ruled by a dictator. The two are obediently taken to the castle, but Nappa wipes out the soldiers and easily defeats the ultimate monster weapon.

episodes.title: Global Training
episodes.summary: Catnap on the Serpent Road — Goku Takes a Tumble Despite being followed around by Lunch, Tenshinhan continues his training with Chiaotzu at a waterfall deep in the mountains. After hearing the story of Krillin and Bulma, he decides to undergo training from Kami. At the same time, Goku has finally made it halfway down the Snake Path.

episodes.title: Goz and Mez
episodes.summary: Hands Off! Enma-sama's Secret Fruit Tenshinhan and his friends start climbing the Karin Tower to undergo training from God. At the same time, Goku slips off Snake Way while sleeping and falls into Hell. Unable to return, Goku tries to eat the fruit of the Enshou Tree, but the demons Gozu and Mezu notice him. However, after hearing the story, they challenge Goku to a game of tag, on the condition that they show him the way out of Snake Way.

episodes.title: Princess Snake
episodes.summary: Such Sweet Temptation! The Snake Princess's Hospitality Krillin and the others begin their training at Kami's Lookout. Then, Goku returns to Snake Way and discovers a mansion along the way, where he is drawn in by a mysterious force. What's more, the owner of the mansion, the Snake Princess, falls in love with Goku at first sight. She uses various tactics to try and stop him, but Goku evades all of her temptations and tries to hurry on.

episodes.title: Dueling Piccolos
episodes.summary: Escape from Piccolo! Gohan Summons a Storm When Goku had finally traveled halfway, Gohan, who was training in the wilderness, became homesick and tried to go back home. However, no matter how much he ran along the coast after passing through the desert, he always ended up back where he started. Curious, Gohan climbed a mountain and discovered that he was on an island.

episodes.title: Plight of the Children
episodes.summary: Run, Gohan! Longing for Mt. Paozu, Where Chi-Chi is Waiting Gohan is caught in a storm and thrown into the sea, where he washes up on a shore where he is rescued by some unknown children. The group is orphans who have lost their parents and are living alone in the ruins, led by the eldest, Piguero. They refuse to be placed in an orphanage and have been on the run.

episodes.title: Pendulum Room Peril
episodes.summary: City of No Tomorrow! The Long Road to Victory Piccolo and Gohan return to the wilderness and begin their training. After that, Krillin and the others, who are fed up with not receiving much training, are led to a room where all time is mixed together and are sent on a journey through time. Having traveled through time and space, the four are suddenly attacked by a mysterious duo.

episodes.title: The End of Snake Way
episodes.summary: Last Stop on Serpent Road! Are you Kaiō-sama? Six months have passed since the tail was cut off, and Gohan's tail has regenerated and he has once again transformed into a giant monkey! Piccolo immediately tries to destroy the moon, but no matter how much he attacks, he is unable to destroy it. Meanwhile, Goku has finally reached the end of the Snake Way.

episodes.title: Defying Gravity
episodes.summary: The Battle with Gravity! Catch Bubbles-kun Goku finally meets King Kai on King Kai's planet. He somehow manages to pass the gag test (?) set by King Kai, who loves puns, and finally begins his training on King Kai's planet. He chases King Kai's pet Bubbles for three weeks in gravity ten times that of Earth. After Goku successfully overcomes gravity and captures Bubbles, King Kai has certain expectations of him.

episodes.title: Goku's Ancestors
episodes.summary: The Return of the Saiyan Legend! Goku's Roots The next training that King Kai assigns to Goku is to hit Gregory with a hammer. Gregory is faster than Bubbles, so Goku desperately pursues him! One day, King Kai tells Goku the history of the evil Saiyans and how they were wiped out, leaving only four of them.

episodes.title: Counting Down
episodes.summary: Come Forth, Shenlong! The Saiyans Finally Arrive on Earth Goku finishes his training on King Kai's planet and tests the power of the super technique, the Spirit Bomb, taught to him by King Kai. However, the Saiyans are approaching Earth sooner than expected. Furthermore, King Kai's miscalculation is discovered, and Goku is forced to return to the lower world in a hurry.

episodes.title: The Darkest Day
episodes.summary: Unbelievable!! Saibaimen, Born from the Soil The Saiyans Vegeta and Nappa landed on Earth, searching for the one with the highest combat ability, and flew to where Piccolo and Gohan were.

episodes.title: Saibamen Attack!
episodes.summary: Yamcha Dies! The Terror of the Saibaiman Krillin, Piccolo, and Gohan stand face to face with the sinister Saiyans and their diabolical henchmen. The villains have already proven terrifyingly powerful. Can Earth's heroes hold out until Goku arrives?

episodes.title: The Power of Nappa
episodes.summary: Farewell, Ten-san! Chaozu's Suicide Strategy Enraged over the loss of Yamcha, Krillin unleashes a powerful attack that destroys the maniacal Saibamen once and for all. Now Earth's defenders must battle the Saiyans themselves - starting with Nappa.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Tenshinhan Cries Out!! This is My Last Kikōhō Chiaotzu sacrifices himself to save his friends from Nappa, but when the smoke clears, the villain still stands! Luckily, Tenshinhan has one trick left that could forever silence the Saiyan warrior!

episodes.title: Nappa's Rampage
episodes.summary: An Intense 3-Hour Delay! The Kinto-Un Bullet-Express Vegeta has called a halt to the fighting, and Nappa uses the time to go on a rampage! Meanwhile, Goku reaches the end of Snake Way and races to re-join his friends - but is he already too late?

episodes.title: Nimbus Speed
episodes.summary: Leave it to Me! Gohan's Great Burst of Anger Piccolo, Gohan, and Krillin do their best to stop the Saiyans from finding the Dragon Balls. Meanwhile, Goku rushes back to Earth on the Flying Nimbus, armed with more power than ever before!

episodes.title: Goku's Arrival
episodes.summary: Ferocity of the Saiyans! God and Piccolo Both Die! Piccolo makes the ultimate sacrifice to save Gohan from the rampaging Saiyans. Just when all seems lost, Goku returns to Earth with an incredible new level of power and confronts the invaders.

episodes.title: Lesson Number One
episodes.summary: Father is Awesome! The Ultimate Finishing Technique: Kaiō-Ken Locked in battle with the Saiyans, Goku gives Nappa a brutal demonstration of the training he received from King Kai. Broken and defeated, Nappa must now face the ferocious wrath of Vegeta!

episodes.title: Goku vs. Vegeta
episodes.summary: A Hot, Unbounded Battle! Goku vs Vegeta Goku decides to take on mighty Vegeta all by himself! The two appear evenly matched, but both are hiding their true strength. The epic battle is underway - which mighty warrior will claim victory?

episodes.title: Saiyan Sized Secret
episodes.summary: Now, Goku! A Final Technique with Everything on the Line Vegeta and Goku continue trading brutal blows, but the action intensifies when Vegeta reveals the secret power of the Saiyans: the ability to transform into a giant, planet-destroying ape!

episodes.title: Spirit Bomb Away!
episodes.summary: Battle Power Times 10!! Vegeta's Great Transformation Goku feels the brunt of Vegeta's fully-realised Saiyan power! Earth's greatest hero is left with no choice except to use the Spirit Bomb. If his attack fails, he may find himself completely doomed!

episodes.title: Hero in the Shadows
episodes.summary: Don't Die, Father!! This is Gohan's Hidden Strength With Goku caught in the clutches of the giant ape Vegeta, Krillin attacks with his Destructo Disk! When his effort falls short, an unlikely hero steps out of the shadows!

episodes.title: Krillin's Offensive
episodes.summary: Shoot, Kuririn! The Genki-Dama, Packed with Hope Goku passes the power of the Spirit Bomb to Krillin, who - with King Kai's guidance - launches the bomb at Vegeta. The Saiyan is sent flying into the sky, but is the evil warrior really gone for good?

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.summary: Cause a Miracle! The Super Saiyan Son Gohan Vegeta is crushed beneath the full weight of Gohan's giant ape form! With the Saiyan battered and defeated, Krillin moves to finish the Saiyan with a final blow - but Goku has other plans.

episodes.title: Picking Up the Pieces
episodes.summary: We're Off Into Space! The Planet of Hope is Piccolo's Homeland The gang mourns the loss of Yamcha, Tenshinhan, Chiaotzu, and Piccolo. With Kami gone, Earth's Dragon Balls have disappeared. Will the surviving heroes find a way to wish their fallen friends back to life?

episodes.title: Plans for Departure
episodes.summary: The Mysterious Yunzabit! The Search for Kami-sama's Spaceship Bulma accidentally destroys the Saiyan spaceship! Luckily, Mr. Popo reveals the existence of another ship that may be able to reach Namek. Can they find it in time, and will the old ship still work if they do?

episodes.title: Nursing Wounds
episodes.summary: Blast-off for Planet Namek! The Terror Awaiting Gohan and Company Goku, Krillin, and Gohan prepare for the return of the Saiyans. Meanwhile, Bulma and Mr. Popo search for a second spaceship capable of transporting her to Planet Namek.

episodes.title: Friends or Foes?
episodes.summary: Friends or Foes? Children of the Mysterious Giant Spaceship Gohan, Bulma, and Krillin blast off for Planet Namek in search of the magic Dragon Balls, but their journey quickly turns chaotic when they encounter a bizarre situation in the vacuum of space!

episodes.title: Held Captive
episodes.summary: Really, for Real? There Lies Namek, Planet of Hope Bulma, Gohan, and Krillin are mistaken for friends of Frieza and taken prisoner by an angry army of children! To regain their freedom and continue on their mission, the gang must convince the kids of their innocence.

episodes.title: Look Out Below
episodes.summary: Kind-hearted Aliens — There's the Five-Star Ball Already A near-fatal crash landing turns out to have a silver lining when Bulma, Gohan, and Krillin are rescued by two friendly Namekians who agree to help them locate the seven Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: The Search Continues
episodes.summary: Planet Freeza No. 79 — Vegeta Recovers!! Gohan, Krillin, and Bulma continue their search for the Dragon Balls with the help of their new friend Zarkro. Back on Earth, Goku has escaped from the hospital to begin training for his upcoming re-match with Vegeta.

episodes.title: A Friendly Surprise
episodes.summary: The Dragon Balls Are All Here! Piccolo-san Comes Back to Life As Bulma, Krillin, and Gohan close in on the last of the Dragon Balls, they uncover a shocking secret about their Namekian friends. Meanwhile, Goku works to build up his strength, and Vegeta sets his sights on revenge!

episodes.title: Brood of Evil
episodes.summary: A Tough New Enemy! Emperor of the Universe, Freeza Bulma, Krillin, and Gohan finally continue their quest to locate all seven Dragon balls. Unfortunately, the gang soon discovers that they aren't the only ones seeking the magical balls.

episodes.title: Frieza Strikes!
episodes.summary: Vegeta's Ambition! I am the Greatest Warrior in the Universe!! Krillin, Gohan, and Bulma are horrified to see Vegeta's space pod land on Planet Namek, but the Saiyan Prince is the least of their problems. Yet another epically evil villain has come to Namek in search of the Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Defying Orders
episodes.summary: Goku's Power at Full-Force!! Six Days to the End of the Galaxy With the odds rapidly mounting against them, Krillin and Gohan will need some serious help if they hope to recover the Dragon Balls from Frieza and his henchmen.

episodes.title: Namek's Defense
episodes.summary: Surprise Attack!! The Elder's Target was the Scouter Krillin and Gohan get their first glimpse of Frieza's cruelty as the villain unleashes his henchmen upon an unsuspecting Namek village. Frieza wants the fifth Dragon Ball, and he is prepared to learn its location by any means necessary!

episodes.title: The Hunted
episodes.summary: Gohan in Peril! A Pursuing Dodoria Summons Death Gohan risks his life to rescue a Namek boy from the clutches of Frieza's evil henchmen. Now Gohan and Krillin have an even bigger problem on their hands: Dodoria is chasing them, and he won't stop until he has his revenge!

episodes.title: The Prince Fights Back
episodes.summary: Dodoria Dies by Explosion! Vegeta's Fearsome Shockwave Dodoria's search for Krillin and Gohan brings him face to face with an unexpected foe - Vegeta! The Saiyan prince has a score to settle with Dodoria, and the time for a final showdown between these two powerful villains has arrived!

episodes.title: Unexpected Problem
episodes.summary: Escape From a Burning Planet!! A Life-or-Death Kamehameha Goku's journey to Namek takes an unexpected detour when his spaceship is knocked off course by an asteroid! Goku has to act fast to get his ship back on track because he's headed straight for the fiery centre of a star!

episodes.title: Vegeta has a Ball
episodes.summary: Courage Times One Hundred! The Warriors Gather Under Kaiō With his new abilities, Vegeta quickly tracks down and forcefully acquires another Dragon Ball. Now, there is only one magic orb left to find, and Dende knows who has it - the Eldest Namekian!

episodes.title: The Past and the Future
episodes.summary: Listen to Me Goku! Hands Off Freeza King Kai becomes concerned after learning that Goku is on a collision course with the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, back on Planet Namek, the battle between Vegeta and Zarbon has begun!

episodes.title: Zarbon's Special Surprise
episodes.summary: Nothing but Goosebumps! The Handsome Warrior Zarbon's Devilish Transformation Vegeta's latest battle heats up as Zarbon reveals his true power: the ability to transform into a monstrous beast! With his increased size and strength, Zarbon seems ready to turn the lights out on the Saiyan Prince - permanently!

episodes.title: Guru's Gift
episodes.summary: Defend the Planet of Hope!! Kuririn's Astonishing Power-Up When Krillin speaks to the Eldest Namekian, he gets a double surprise! Not only does he receive a Dragon Ball, but the sleeping powers within him are awoken! Will Krillin's incredible new strength be enough to save his friends?

episodes.title: Piccolo vs. Everyone
episodes.summary: Back from the Brink of Death — The Miracle Man, Vegeta On Kaio's planet, Tenshinhan and the others continue their training against Bubbles and Gregory, but Piccolo, who has doubts about the results of his training, is the only one who does not participate. However, when they start sparring, Piccolo is surprised at how much Yamcha's skills have improved since before. Meanwhile, on Planet Namek, Vegeta has been treated from his injuries and has made a comeback.

episodes.title: Zarbon's Mission
episodes.summary: An Enormous Battle Power!! Freeza's Strategy is Shattered Vegeta steals the Dragon Ball from Freeza's spaceship and escapes! In an attempt to collect them all at once, he chases Krillin, who rushes to Bulma with the last one, but Zarbon, who notices the chase, appears and they are on the brink of an explosive confrontation. Meanwhile, Gohan takes advantage of Vegeta's distraction and gets the Dragon Ball that was sunk in the pond.

episodes.title: Gohan, the Hunted
episodes.summary: I'm Back to My Old Self Again!! Goku Takes on 100 Times Gravity Vegeta, who is after Krillin's Dragon Ball, and Zarbon, who has been chasing him, meet again. However, Vegeta easily defeats Zarbon after he transforms. Resigned to his strength, Krillin hands over the last Dragon Ball. At the same time, Goku inside the spaceship continues to fight against 100 times the gravity caused by a magnetic storm.

episodes.title: Unknown Enemies
episodes.summary: Freeza's Secret Weapon! The Devilish Ginyu Special Squadron The Ginyu Special Forces launch from Planet Freeza! At their destination, Planet Namek, Gohan returns to Bulma with the Dragon Ball, but is discovered by Vegeta. However, Gohan quickly hides the Dragon Ball from Vegeta, and without a moment's rest, he rushes to the Elder's house with Krillin to have his potential unlocked.

episodes.title: Destination: Guru
episodes.summary: Bulma, Watch Out!! The Four-Star Ball Falls into Freeza's Hands Freeza unleashes a gigantic blast of energy that shakes the earth, causing Bulma's four-star ball to fall into the sea. Bulma hurriedly dives into the sea in a submarine and confronts a giant crab guarding the Dragon Ball and countless eggs. She manages to retrieve the Dragon Ball safely and return to the surface, but is then captured by Freeza's minions.

episodes.title: Bulma's Big Day
episodes.summary: Charge!! The Kaiō-Ken and Kamehameha of an Indomitable Spirit Freeza's subordinates hear Bulma's story and start plotting to get the Dragon Balls for themselves. Bulma tricks them into thinking there are still Dragon Balls remaining in the ocean and takes them on a tour of the ocean in a submarine, but her lie is exposed along the way! Meanwhile, inside the spaceship, Goku has overcome 100 times the gravity.

episodes.title: Hidden Power
episodes.summary: The Great Battle Approaches! The Ginyu Special Squadron Takes the Stage!! After successfully completing his training, Goku rests on the spaceship in preparation for the final battle on Planet Namek. Meanwhile, Krillin and Gohan finally arrive at the Elder's place, where they encounter Vegeta. They manage to draw out Gohan's power, but it is no match for Vegeta's. Then, five large powers approach Planet Namek.

episodes.title: New Ally, New Problem
episodes.summary: Goku on Final Approach! Smash through Freeza's Dragnet The Ginyu Force finally arrives on Planet Namek. The only way to defeat them is to make Vegeta immortal with the power of the Dragon Balls... Krillin and the others work with Vegeta to collect the Dragon Balls, but then the Ginyu Force appears.

episodes.title: Guldo's Mind Binds
episodes.summary: Is This Some Super-Magic or Just a Trick!? Mr. Gurd is Angry! The battle with the Ginyu Force begins, as Gohan and Krillin launch a barrage of explosive energy blasts at Guldo! The Heroes are rendered helpless by Guldo's Mind Blind technique, and this time, there is no one to save them!

episodes.title: Recoome Unleashed
episodes.summary: The Savage Reacoom! The Bad, Strong, and Outrageous Guy After defeating Guldo with a surprise attack, Vegeta faces off against Recoome. Vegeta launches a preemptive attack at full power, but even an attack with a battle power of 20,000 is ineffective against Recoome. Vegeta is left on the brink of death by the powerful attack. Just as he is about to be hit by Recoome's Eraser Gun, Krillin's quick thinking saves him.

episodes.title: Let the Battle Begin
episodes.summary: Don't Die, Gohan! Goku Finally Touches Down on the Battlefield Having collected all seven Dragon Balls, Freeza heads to the Elder to find out how to grant his wish. Meanwhile, Gohan attacks Recoome. He fights with all his might, but Recoome doesn't look too worried.

episodes.title: Goku's New Power
episodes.summary: Uncommon Strength!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son Goku Finally, Goku arrives. Understanding the entire situation, Goku gives Senzu Beans not only to Gohan and Krillin, but also to Vegeta. After making sure that the three are well, Goku goes up against Recoome by himself. Krillin and the others are worried that Goku is too calm, but Goku defeats Recoome with just one blow.

episodes.title: A Legend Revealed
episodes.summary: Lightning Balls of Red and Blue! Jheese and Butta Attack Goku Jeice and Burter let their guard down when they see Goku's power level of 5,000 on their scouter, and begin their attack. However, even when the two of them launch direct attacks using their boastworthy speed, they are unable to land a single blow. Feeling that they are at a disadvantage in the hand-to-hand combat, the two finally activate their combined technique.

episodes.title: Ginyu Assault
episodes.summary: At Last, a Direct Confrontation!! Captain Ginyu Takes the Field In order to get Jeice and Burter to back off, Goku knocks Burter unconscious with one blow, showing the difference in their strength. Frightened by Goku's power, Jeice flies off to Commander Ginyu. Vegeta, infuriated that Jeice had escaped, finishes off Burter and Recoome, and berates Goku for being too soft on him. Meanwhile, Ginyu receives Jeice's report...

episodes.title: Incredible Force!
episodes.summary: Incredible Force!! Did You See It, Goku's Full Power? As the battle between Goku and Captain Ginyu rages on, Gohan and Krillin steal the unguarded Dragon Balls from Frieza's ship. It's a race against time, and our heroes must unlock the power of the Dragon Balls before it's too late!

episodes.title: Frieza Approaches
episodes.summary: What of the Battle's Outcome?! Freeza's Evil Hand Closes Around the Eldest Goku astounds Captain Ginyu with his amazing new powers, but the Captain still has a few tricks up his sleeve! Meanwhile, Frieza arrives at the home of the Eldest Namek and begins a battle with the noble warrior, Nail!

episodes.title: Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is Goku
episodes.summary: Surprise!! Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is Goku In an attempt to save the Elder, Nail fights a hopeless battle against the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, finding himself no match for Goku's superior abilities, Captain Ginyu unleashes his ultimate attack, the Body Switch Technique!

episodes.title: Calling the Eternal Dragon
episodes.summary: Come Forth, Super Shenlong!! Grant Me My Wish Armed with the Dragon Radar, Gohan and Krillin recover the seven Dragon Balls from their hiding places. But before they can summon the Eternal Dragon to make their wish, they are confronted by a powerful new enemy - Goku?!

episodes.title: Gohan, Defeat Your Dad!!
episodes.summary: That Ain't Me! Gohan, Don't Lose Your Nerve, Hit Your Father!! After taking control of Goku's body, Captain Ginyu turns his attention to Gohan and Krillin! With Goku trapped in the Captain's broken body, it's up to Gohan to stop the rampaging Ginyu!

episodes.title: Captain Ginyu...The Frog
episodes.summary: A Huge Miscalculation!! Ginyu Has Turned into a Frog As the bout between Captain Ginyu and Vegeta heats up, Goku summons the last of his strength and tricks his foe into reversing the Body Switch Technique. Now, Goku, Krillin, and Gohan must join forces with Vegeta for the battle with Frieza.

episodes.title: Password is Porunga
episodes.summary: Start of the "Frieza Saga". Goku recovers in the isolation chamber, Gohan guards the dragon balls, and Vegeta rests while they all wait on Krillin's return; Dende looks for Krillin and Gohan; Frieza finishes interrogating Nail.

episodes.title: Piccolo's Return
episodes.summary: With Porunga summoned, Krillin, Gohan, and Dende make their wishes after Gohan consults with Piccolo; Vegeta grows angry when he wakes up and realizes what has happened; Frieza flies toward the Z Fighters.

episodes.title: The Fusion
episodes.summary: Frieza powers up while everyone watches; Nail tries to convince Piccolo to merge with him; the battle with Frieza begins.

episodes.title: Fighting Power: One Million??
episodes.summary: Frieza talks about his history with Vegeta's father and his attempted rebellion, and he transforms into a more powerful version of himself; Bulma runs from a dinosaur stampede.

episodes.title: Gohan Attacks
episodes.summary: Frieza tortures Krillin; Yamcha becomes frustrated because he can't help his friends; Bulma despairs; in a rage, Gohan attacks Frieza.

episodes.title: Piccolo the Super-Namek
episodes.summary: The Tide Suddenly Turns!! Piccolo, the Warrior Who Came Late Vegeta witnesses Gohan's attack, but is unable to do anything due to the vast difference in strength. Just as Frieza is about to finish off Gohan, Krillin's Kienzan cuts Frieza's tail. Frieza is puzzled, and Krillin provokes him, running away. Dende takes advantage of the opportunity to rush over to Gohan. What power does Dende possess?

episodes.title: Déjà vu
episodes.summary: Piccolo's Self-Confidence! I Will Be the One to Defeat Freeza Piccolo quickly takes control of the battle with Frieza, and the putrid purple monster is shocked to learn the secret behind his opponent's powers!

episodes.title: Freeza's Second Transformation?
episodes.summary: Sally Forth, Goku!! A Furious Freeza's 2nd Transformation Just as it appears that Piccolo has gained the upper hand, Frieza quickly dashes all hopes for victory by revealing his second monstrous transformation!

episodes.title: Another Transformation?
episodes.summary: Fear Me!! Freeza Does Battle With a 3rd Transformation Unable to watch as Piccolo is overwhelmed by Frieza, Gohan springs into action! Meanwhile, Vegeta devises a risky plan.

episodes.title: Dende's Demise
episodes.summary: The Death of Dende... Come Forth! Intense, Full-Force Power Having reached his ultimate form, Frieza is determined to destroy the remaining Z-fighters one by one, but Vegeta boldly announces the end of Frieza's reign.

episodes.title: The Renewed Goku
episodes.summary: The Moment We've Waited For!!! Son Goku is Revived Vegeta, who firmly believes himself to be a Super Saiyan, fires off a full-power energy blast at Frieza, but it is easily deflected with a kick. He despairs at the overwhelming difference in power. Shedding tears, he experiences failure for the first time in his life... Vegeta has completely lost the will to fight, and just as death draws nearer, Goku's wounds finally heal.

episodes.title: The End of Vegeta
episodes.summary: Such Regret…!! The Proud Saiyan, Vegeta Dies Goku rejoins his friends on the battlefield, but not before Vegeta is defeated by Frieza!

episodes.title: The Ultimate Battle
episodes.summary: The Curtain Opens on the Super Decisive Battle!! I Am Going to Defeat You Goku wages war on the monstrous Frieza! As the fight intensifies, Frieza directs his energy blasts at Namek itself, turning the planet into a lava-spewing warzone.

episodes.title: Clash of the Super Powers
episodes.summary: The Two Great Superpowers Collide! A Physical Battle Where Both Get Serious!!! Goku and Frieza continue their epic battle! An underwater attack puts Goku on top until Frieza traps him in an energy ball!

episodes.title: Freeza's Boast
episodes.summary: Freeza's Terrible Declaration! I Will Defeat You Without Using My Hands Frieza vows to beat Goku without using his hands.

episodes.title: Bold and Fearless
episodes.summary: That Ain't No Bluff!! The Audaciously Wonderful Guy, Son Goku Captain Ginyu returns to the battlefield in Bulma's body!

episodes.title: Embodiment of Fire
episodes.summary: Showdown!! The Embodiment of Flame in a 20-Fold Kaiō-Ken Kamehameha Goku's powerful Kaio-Ken attack has no effect on Frieza.

episodes.title: Trump Card
episodes.summary: An Extra-Large Genki-Dama — This is the Final Trump Card!! Once again, Goku is rescued by a vision!

episodes.title: Keep the Chance Alive
episodes.summary: Seize the Chance!! Piccolo's Suicide Support Strike Yamcha, Tenshinhan, and Chiaotzu find themselves in serious trouble when the Ginyu Force invades King Kai's planet!

episodes.title: Power of the Spirit
episodes.summary: The Incredible Destructive Force of the Genki-Dama!! Who Will Survive?! Chaos erupts on King Kai's planet as the Z-fighters battle the Ginyu Force!

episodes.title: Transformed At Last
episodes.summary: Transformed At Last!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son Goku A victory celebration comes to a halt when Frieza reappears! With no reserves left, Goku watches helplessly as Frieza directs his fury at Piccolo and Krillin.

episodes.title: Explosion of Anger
episodes.summary: An Explosion of Anger!! Goku, Avenge Everyone's Deaths Engulfed in golden light, Goku announces that he is now a Super Saiyan.

episodes.title: Namek's Destruction
episodes.summary: The Destruction of Planet Namek?! A Demonic Flash Penetrates the Ground Finding himself no match for Goku, Frieza attacks Planet Namek! Unable to react in time, Goku is forced to watch helplessly as the fiery blast rips through the planet.

episodes.title: A Final Attack
episodes.summary: I Am Going To Win… Risking Survival, A Final Attack With only minutes to go before the planet explodes, Frieza reaches his maximum power!

episodes.title: Approaching Destruction
episodes.summary: Shenlong, Fly Through Space!! The Time of Namek's Destruction Draws Near The battle between Goku and Frieza rages on! Back on Earth, the seven Dragon Balls have been restored.

episodes.title: Gohan Returns
episodes.summary: I am Son Goku's Son!! Gohan Returns to the Battlefield Frieza's victims have been wished back to life, but as they begin to rise, Goku falls - overwhelmed by Frieza's devastating assault.

episodes.title: The Last Wish
episodes.summary: I'm Staying on This Planet!! A Final Wish Toward Victory The Eldest and the people of Namek have been brought back to life, and the dragon Porunga has reappeared to grant the last of three wishes.

episodes.title: Duel On A Vanishing Planet
episodes.summary: Let's Get It On!! Two Remain on a Vanishing Planet Goku chooses to stay behind and finish his fight with Frieza.

episodes.title: Pathos Of Frieza
episodes.summary: Pathos of Freeza! Once He Starts Shaking He's Unstoppable!! Time grows short for Goku as each passing second brings Namek closer to destruction.

episodes.title: Frieza Defeated!
episodes.summary: Goku's Declaration of Victory!! As Freeza Destroys Himself… Frieza lashes out in a blind rage, launching a reckless volley of energy attacks. In the face of Goku's superior power, the evil tyrant's greatest fear has come true.

episodes.title: Mighty Blast of Rage
episodes.summary: Freeza Defeated!! A Single Blast Packed With a Totality of Rage Learning that the Namekian Dragon Balls can revive humans many times, Gohan and the others let out a cry of joy. Now they can bring Krillin and Chiaozu back to life. On Namek, Goku's crushing victory brings an end to the deadly battle. However, as Goku leaves, Freeza strikes the final blow...

episodes.title: Namek's Explosion... Goku's End?
episodes.summary: Planet Namek's Great Explosion!! Goku Disappears into Space Even though it looks like Goku is trapped on the exploding planet Namek, Dende has a good reason to celebrate: the Dragon Balls have the power to bring Goku back to life.

episodes.title: Goku's Alive!!
episodes.summary: Son Goku Survived — The Z Warriors Are All Resurrected!! It is a time of joyful reunions as old friends long absent are finally wished home with the Dragon Balls! Krillin and Yamcha are brought back from the spirit realm.

episodes.title: The Heavens Tremble
episodes.summary: Terrible Happenings in Heaven!! Garlic Jr. Becomes God?! Gohan's going fishing, Krillin's found a girlfriend, and it looks as though peace has once again returned to the Earth.

episodes.title: Black Fog of Terror
episodes.summary: Black Mist of Terror…!! Everyone Turns Demonic Garlic Junior releases the Black Water Mist upon an unsuspecting world. As the dreaded fog spreads, so does Garlic Junior's control over the Earth!

episodes.title: Battle in Kami's Lookout
episodes.summary: The Heavens Become the Battlefield!! Piccolo Becomes Devilish Again… As Piccolo attempts to hold off the Spice Boys and the infected Z Fighters, Gohan and Krillin race toward Kami's Lookout.

episodes.title: Fight With Piccolo
episodes.summary: Gohan and Krillin fight the Spice Boys; Yajirobe and Korin cook for Maron; Vegeta trains on a distant planet while looking for answers.

episodes.title: Call For Restoration
episodes.summary: Restore Everyone's Minds!! The Ultra Holy Water Resting in the Temple Krillin, after suffering a Spice Boys beating, attempts to free Kami and Mr. Popo, but he soon falls prey to the Black Water Mist.

episodes.title: Suicidal Course
episodes.summary: It Can't Wait Until Morning!! Kami-sama Decides on a Suicidal Course of Action Piccolo and Krillin spring their trap, revealing that they have pretended to be infected by the Black Water Mist!

episodes.title: Extreme Measures
episodes.summary: A Battle of Extreme Measures!! Kami-sama Breaks the Covenant Garlic Junior and his Spice Boys harness the evil power of the Makyo Star to become stronger than ever, but Gohan, Krillin, and Piccolo are ready to battle.

episodes.title: The World Awakens
episodes.summary: The Ultra Holy Water Worked!! The World Awakens From its Nightmare In a last ditch effort to save his friends, Gohan launches an all out assault.

episodes.title: Brief Chance for Victory
episodes.summary: Gohan's Brief Chance for Victory!! Destroy Planet Makyō… Blinded by rage and desperate to destroy his enemies, Garlic Junior uses his power to open up the Dead Zone!

episodes.title: Krillin's Proposal
episodes.summary: You're My Guy… Kuririn — The 101st Proposal Krillin faces his toughest challenge ever: surviving a shopping trip with Maron! And it looks like she's picking out a wedding dress!

episodes.title: Frieza's Counterattack
episodes.summary: That's Earth, Papa… Freeza and his Father Strike Back Gohan's cracking the books, and his new tutor is cracking the whip!

episodes.title: The Mysterious Youth
episodes.summary: I Will Defeat Freeza… The Mysterious Boy Awaiting Goku The Earth faces its darkest hour as Frieza and his father King Cold rapidly approach!

episodes.title: Another Super Saiyan?
episodes.summary: Freeza Halved By a Single Blow!! Another Super Saiyan Frieza and King Cold descend upon the Earth, but a mysterious warrior has come to thwart their diabolical plot for revenge.

episodes.title: Welcome Back Goku
episodes.summary: Heya!! It's Been a While… Son Goku Returns After defeating Frieza and King Cold, the mysterious stranger announces the exact time and place of Goku's arrival on Earth.

episodes.title: Mystery Revealed
episodes.summary: My Dad is Vegeta… Confessions of the Mysterious Boy After testing Goku in combat, the mysterious stranger reveals his true identity!

episodes.title: Goku's Special Technique
episodes.summary: Goku's New Finishing Technique?! Watch This, My Instantaneous Movement The future has been written - or has it? That's what Goku and the rest of the Z-Fighters must decide as they hear Trunks' ominous warning.

episodes.title: Z Warriors Prepare
episodes.summary: I Will Overcome… Goku!! The King of the Saiyan Warrior Race Gohan learns some new tricks, Vegeta pushes himself to the breaking point, and Yamcha struggles just to keep up.

episodes.title: Goku's Ordeal
episodes.summary: License Mastery? Goku's Newest Trial Goku and Piccolo take a day off from training to enroll in driving school. These two mighty warriors may be the Earth's only chance for survival.

episodes.title: The Androids Appear
episodes.summary: Murderers Who Leave No Trace — Which Ones Are the Artificial Humans?! The Androids are here, and they're wreaking havoc on an unsuspecting city! Goku and his friends must now put their training to the test!

episodes.title: A Handy Trick
episodes.summary: The Cold-Blooded No. 20's Hideous Atrocities!! Goku's Super Transformation of Anger Yamcha is held at the mercy of the ruthless No. 20, and Goku and the others must race to help their friend.

episodes.title: Double Trouble for Goku
episodes.summary: Goku's Double-Shock!! Caught Between Illness and Adversary The battle with the Androids begins as Goku launches an all out assault against #19. The Super Saiyan seems to have the fight under control.

episodes.title: Upgrade to Super Saiyan
episodes.summary: The Might of Vegeta!! The Blood of a Super Saiyan Awakens Attacked from within by a crippling virus, Goku is helpless against the maniacal #19. But just when it looks like the end for Goku, Vegeta appears on on the scene.

episodes.title: The Secret of Doctor Gero
episodes.summary: No. 20's Defiant Smile… The Secret of Doctor Gero In his first fight as a Super Saiyan, Vegeta takes control of the battlefield.

episodes.title: More Androids?!
episodes.summary: A Present More Terrifying Than the Future?! Trunks' Suspicions Vegeta, Piccolo, and Gohan lead an exhaustive search through the mountains for #20. But the hunters are also the hunted!

episodes.title: Follow Dr. Gero
episodes.summary: During the confusion after the explosion of Bulma's ship, Android 20 retreats to activate Androids 17 and 18; Trunks grows angry with Vegeta for not trying to save Bulma; the Z Fighters debate their next move.

episodes.title: Nightmare Comes True
episodes.summary: The Z Fighters look for Dr. Gero's lab while he tries to beat them there; Gohan flies Bulma, baby Trunks, and Yajirobe home; Goku fights the virus.

episodes.title: Goku's Assassin
episodes.summary: After Androids 17 and 18 mutiny on Dr. Gero, they activate Android 16 and go after Goku. Vegeta follows the Androids while Goku continues to fight the virus as Chi-Chi cooks for him. Gohan stops so that Bulma and Yajirobe can change Trunks' diaper.

episodes.title: Deadly Beauty
episodes.summary: Vegeta fights Android 18 while the rest of the Z Fighters fly toward the battle; Gohan continues to fly Bulma, Trunks, and Yajirobe home; Maron surfs while she stays at Roshi's house.

episodes.title: No Match for the Androids
episodes.summary: The rest of the Z Fighters jump in to help Vegeta, and Android 17 joins the fight; Turtle saves Maron from drowning and fights off two guys who are trying to pick her up.

episodes.title: Last Ditch Effort
episodes.summary: Krillin heals everyone with senzu beans. Vegeta flies off in a rage and Piccolo goes to the Lookout to speak with Kami. Krillin, Trunks, and Tien go to pick up Goku, who is still fighting the virus while Maron leaves Roshi's house. Gohan drops off Bulma, baby Trunks, and Yajirobe at Dr. Brief's house.

episodes.title: Closing In
episodes.summary: Piccolo tries to convince Kami to merge with him; Tien goes to pick up Chiaotzu while Krillin and Trunks continue on to pick up Goku; the Androids hijack a truck, and they run afoul of a motorcycle gang.

episodes.title: Unwelcome Discovery
episodes.summary: UNWELCOME DISCOVERY : Tien picks up Chiaotzu while the rest of the Z Fighters fly to Roshi's house as Trunks thinks about his world and how to defeat the Androids. Goku dreams about the Androids and the Androids in turn continue driving to Goku's house. Vegeta vows to ascend to an even more powerful level and Bulma reports a strange finding to Krillin and Trunks.

episodes.title: Seized with Fear
episodes.summary: Trunks and Krillin join Bulma at the crash site of the mysterious time capsule and find an eerie clue: the shell of a large, locust-like creature! Whatever arrived in the time capsule isn't human, and it's on the loose!

episodes.title: The Reunion
episodes.summary: An insect-like monster threatens to turn Gingertown into a ghastly graveyard! In response to this new menace, Kami fuses with Piccolo, and the resulting Super Namekian flies to Gingertown for a showdown of epic proportions!

episodes.title: Borrowed Powers
episodes.summary: Gingertown becomes a battlefield as Piccolo confronts Cell. This monster from the future gains his strength by sucking the life out of his victims! But that's not the creature's only talent. He also knows the Kamehameha Wave!

episodes.title: His Name Is Cell
episodes.summary: A Life Form of Evil and Destruction!! His Name is Artificial Human Cell Heavily-armored tanks fail to halt Cell's rampage, and now it's up to Piccolo to stop the monster! As the Namekian fights for survival, Cell reveals that he's actually an android, the ultimate achievement of Dr. Gero!

episodes.title: Piccolo's Folly
episodes.summary: Piccolo's Grievous Mistake! Cell Escapes Into the City! Piccolo cleverly distracts Cell long enough to regenerate his arm. The Namekian is ready for another round, and Krillin and Trunks have arrived to provide backup! With the odds mounting against him, Cell makes a tactical decision.

episodes.title: Laboratory Basement
episodes.summary: The Secret of Cell's Birth! What Lies Below the Laboratory?! With hopes of saving the future, Trunks and Krillin race to destroy Dr. Gero's lab. Meanwhile, Piccolo and Tien search for the elusive Cell. But how can they stop an enemy who knows their every move?

episodes.title: Our Hero Awakes
episodes.summary: Goku Awakens to Battle! Go Beyond the Super Saiyan!! In South City, Cell plows through more civilians and accidentally runs into Krillin! Goku finally gets back on his feet, but with Cell and the other androids in full stride, can the Saiyan hero still make a difference?

episodes.title: Time Chamber
episodes.summary: Hasten Your Training, Saiyans! In the Room of Spirit and Time… As Cell continues his deadly march, Goku hatches a plan to squeeze a year's worth of training into just one day! Back at Master Roshi's, the android trio arrives looking for Goku! Can Piccolo hold them off until the Saiyans return?

episodes.title: The Monster is Coming
episodes.summary: The Gekiretsu Kodan that Split the Heavens!! Piccolo vs Artificial Human No. 17 Behind the closed doors of the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, Vegeta and Trunks struggle to push past the level of Super Saiyan! Down on Earth, Piccolo challenges Android 17 to a battle!

episodes.title: He's Here
episodes.summary: How I Have Waited For this Day!! Cell's Prologue to Perfection Stronger than ever after fusing with Kami, Piccolo leads the attack against the androids! It looks like the Super Namekian has things under control until Cell arrives on the battlefield! Can anyone stop this hideous monster?!

episodes.title: Up to Piccolo
episodes.summary: The Suicidal Counterattack Proves Ineffective! Piccolo's Flame Burns Out!! Just as Cell is about to absorb Android 17, Piccolo bravely steps in and foils the monster's plan! Does the Super Namekian really have a chance at stopping Cell on his own?! Or is he simply putting off the inevitable?

episodes.title: Silent Warrior
episodes.summary: One Final Remaining Hope… The Silent Warrior No. 16 Takes Action!! When Android 16 claims to be as strong as Cell, it seems like a wild boast! But after he launches an offensive that throws Cell against the ropes, it becomes clear that the big android has the power to back up his words!

episodes.title: Say Goodbye, 17
episodes.summary: No. 17 is Swallowed… The Transforming Cell is a Super Gourmet It's android against android as 16 clashes with Cell. Android 16 is the stronger fighter, but Cell is far too driven to be stopped now! With an underheanded attack, Cell moves one step closer to his gruesome transformation!

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Tomorrow I am Going to Pulverize You!! Goku's Challenge With an onslaught of psychic blasts, Tien gives Androids 16 and 18 a chance to escape, but the powerful attack rapidly drains his strength. Tien may have saved the androids, but can he save himself?

episodes.title: Saiyans Emerge
episodes.summary: I'll Finish Everything!! A Reborn Vegeta, Father and Son, Sally Forth Trunks and Vegeta emerge from the time chamber after a year of intense training. Goku and Gohan are next into the room, but with Cell nearing his ultimate form, can the fighters afford to wait another day?

episodes.title: Super Vegeta
episodes.summary: Suddenly Full-Throttle!! The Radiant Vegeta's Super Power Cell obliterates a chain of islands in search of Android 18! Vegeta, fresh from the time chamber, is ready to test his new strength against the monster, but is he really stronger than a Super Saiyan?

episodes.title: Bow to the Prince
episodes.summary: On Your Knees, Cell! I am Super Vegeta!! Vegeta shows cell his new power while Goku and Gohun train.

episodes.title: Hour of Temptation
episodes.summary: Vegeta continues his fight with Cell. In the Time Chamber, Goku trains his Kamehameha Wave, and Gohan convinces Goku to let him train harder after having a dream of almost becoming a Super Saiyan.

episodes.title: Krillin's Decision
episodes.summary: Cell tries to convince Vegeta to allow him to absorb Android 18 in order to reach his perfect form, thus giving Vegeta the challenge he desires. Meanwhile, Krillin tries to get close enough to the Androids to use the remote and destroy 18, but his feelings for her get in the way.

episodes.title: The Last Defense
episodes.summary: A Shock to the Entire Universe!! Cell, A Spectacular Evolution Toward His Perfect Form With the remote control smashed, Krillin and Trunks must save Android 18 from Cell's power-hungry grasp. But Vegeta has other plans in mind. Will trunks attack his own father to save humanity?

episodes.title: Cell is Complete
episodes.summary: An Infinite Battle Power!! The Birth of the God of Destruction is Named Cell The earth's greatest fear has come true: Cell is complete! Can anyone stop the android nightmare in his final, perfect form? As the heroes nervously line up, a glimmer of hope shines from above. Gohan is a Super Saiyan!

episodes.title: Vegeta Must Pay
episodes.summary: Super Vegeta in Peril!! An Absolutely Perfect Terror Closes In!! After allowing Cell to reach his final form, Vegeta is ready for the challenge he was promised. But as Cell easily deflects the Saiyan's every blow, it's clear that Vegeta has more his hands than he bargained for!

episodes.title: Trunks Ascends
episodes.summary: Breaking Through the Boundaries of the Super Saiyan!! Trunks Summons a Storm Tapping into the deepest wells of his energy, Vegeta summons one last attack: the Final Flash! Meanwhile, Trunks struggles to decide whether or not to help his father. Vegeta's pride is at stake, but so is his life!

episodes.title: Saving Throw
episodes.summary: Save Your Father!! Trunks' Fury, Which Scorches Even the Heavens Vegeta lies unconscious after his battle with Cell, and Trunks unleashes his hidden powers to save his father's life. With Goku and Gohan still training, Trunks is the only person standing in the evil android's way.

episodes.title: Ghosts from Tomorrow
episodes.summary: A Future of Despair!! Trunks, the Man Who Lived Through Hell Trunks vows to stop the future from repeating itself; Cell can't wait for the future to unfold. It's all up for grabs as the two warriors prepare for battle. Only one future will survive. Whose will it be?

episodes.title: The Cell Games
episodes.summary: Super Trunks Has a Weakness!! Cell, A Shocking Bombshell Declaration Realizing that his powers are no match for his opponent, Trunks accepts defeat, only to be given a second chance when Cell proposes a tournament! Is Cell really interested in competition, or does he have a sinister motive?

episodes.title: What is the Tournament?
episodes.summary: Start of the "Cell Games Saga". Trunks explains Cell's tournament to the Z Fighters; Krillin takes Android 16 to Bulma so that she can repair him; Goku and Gohan continue to train in the Time Chamber; Roshi recaps the events of the previous World Martial Arts Tournaments; Cell builds an arena for his tournament.

episodes.title: The Doomsday Broadcast
episodes.summary: Dr. Brief takes a look at Android 16; Yamcha and Krillin decide to train; Gohan has a bad dream about Cell; Cell announces his tournament on TV.

episodes.title: Meet Me in the Ring
episodes.summary: Goku and Gohan emerge from the Time Chamber, and Goku uses his instant transmission to pay a visit to Cell in order to see how powerful he is in his perfect form; meanwhile, people are fleeing from the cities and Dr. Brief and Bulma run tests on Android 16.

episodes.title: No Worries Here
episodes.summary: Goku asks Korin to compare his strength to Cell's. He and Gohan then pick up Chi-Chi from Roshi's, and they spend the rest of the day relaxing and fishing with Krillin. Meanwhile, Cell trains in space.

episodes.title: A Girl Named Lime
episodes.summary: While on an errand for his mom, Gohan stops in Chazke Village. He finds that Mr. Bourbon, the tycoon who runs the city, has built a shelter to protect the town from Cell, and that he manipulates the townspeople into doing what he wants. To make matters worse, he has hired General Tao as his right hand man. Along with an elderly shopkeeper named Lao and Lao's granddaughter Lime, Gohan tries to convince the people of Bourbon's and Tao's treachery, and that the shelter won't protect them from Cell.

episodes.title: Memories of Gohan
episodes.summary: Chi-Chi kicks Goku out of the house so that she can prepare for Gohan's birthday party. She looks through a photo album and thinks back on how she and Goku chose Gohan's name. Meanwhile, Goku fishes with Krillin, and he recalls a time when he lost control of Gohan's stroller.

episodes.title: A New Guardian
episodes.summary: Piccolo emerges from the Time Chamber, and Vegeta enters; Bulma works on Android 16; Goku, Gohan, Krillin, and Chi-Chi have a picnic; the military attacks Cell; Goku sets out to find a new guardian for Earth.

episodes.title: Dende's Dragon
episodes.summary: Dende's New Occupation!! The Dragon Balls are Revived With help from King Kai, Goku travels to Namek to recruit a new guardian for the Earth! Most of the Namekians refuse the offer, but there's one little guy who can't wait to go! Dende is back, and he's going to create a new Dragon!

episodes.title: The Puzzle of General Tao
episodes.summary: Goku's Perplexing Problem?! The Dragon Balls are Taken Back Goku comes face to face with an old adversary: General Tao! The search for the Dragon Balls led Goku to the aging general, but unless the Super Saiyan can solve the crafty villain's puzzle, the search may end in vain!

episodes.title: The Games Begin
episodes.summary: Cell's Standing Challenge!! The Opening to the Decisive Battle The wait is over, and the Cell Games are ready to begin! The Z-Fighters arrive ringside, only to discover another challenger already on the scene. It's none other than World Martial Arts Champion, Mr. Satan!

episodes.title: Losers Fight First
episodes.summary: Wait Just a Minute!! The Great Satan Army Arrives Caroni and Pirozhki, Mr. Satan's top students, make a spectacular entrance to the ring, but are they really ready to rumble with Cell? Don't miss a minute of the fun, because this fight could be over fast!

episodes.title: Goku vs. Cell
episodes.summary: Goku's Bout!! The Super-Tense Cell Games Goku and Cell start fighting with each other in the ring. If Cell wins then he'll destroy the earth. If Goku wins then the Cell will give up.

episodes.title: Cell's Bag of Tricks
episodes.summary: A Direct Hit to the Earth!! Cell's Huge Kamehameha Cell attacks Goku with a dazzling array of moves including the Destructo Disk, the Special Beam Cannon, and even the Kamehameha Wave! Goku matches the monster blow for blow, but how long can he last against such a lethal arsenal?

episodes.title: No More Rules
episodes.summary: Lose or Die?! Goku, A Secret Turnabout Plan As the battle intensifies, Cell quickly grows tired of the rules he created for the tournament. With a flick of his finger, the Android destroys the ring, instantly turning the Cell Games into a deadly fight to the finish!

episodes.title: The Fight is Over
episodes.summary: The End of the Desperate Struggle!! Goku Surrenders?! Goku blasts Cell with a Kamehameha Wave that reduces the android to a pile of cinders, but his triumph is short-lived. The monster shows his amazing resilience by fully regenerating himself!

episodes.title: Faith in a Boy
episodes.summary: Someone Who Will Succeed the Strongest… His Name is Gohan After surrendering to Cell, Goku names the next challenger to enter the Cell Games: Gohan! Goku has supreme faith in his son's abilities, but the young Saiyan will need a lot more than his father's confidence if he's going to survive!

episodes.title: Gohan's Plea
episodes.summary: Get Angry, Gohan—Release the Dormant Power Within The fight between Gohan and Cell intensifies, but the villain's attacks seem to have no effect on the boy! Could the young hero really have the power to defeat the evil android once and for all?

episodes.title: Android Explosion
episodes.summary: Miniature Threats!! The Cell Juniors Attack Cell is determined to unleash Gohan's full potential, but the boy refuses to fight, prompting the android to torture Gohan's friends instead! Next, Cell does the unthinkable by spawning miniature Cells to attack the Z-Fighters!

episodes.title: Cell Juniors Attack!
episodes.summary: The Tragedy of No. 16!! Super Gohan's Anger Explodes Gohan boils with rage as the Cell Juniors wreak havoc on the Z-Fighters. The boy struggles to resist the urge to fight, but he's a powder keg waiting to explode, and Android 16 appears ready to light the fuse!

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.summary: Anger Exploding Into Power!! The Cell Juniors are Destroyed "The Unleashing" - After Android 16 tells Gohan to unleash his powers. Gohan becomes super sayan and starts destroying cells children.

episodes.title: The Unstoppable Gohan
episodes.summary: Cell is Knocked Out!! Taken Down With Two Super Punches Cell's desire for battle turns into a nightmare as Gohan unleashes the full fury of his strength. The evil android powers up to his maximum level, but will it be enough to spare him from the wrath of Super Saiyan?

episodes.title: Cell's Break Down
episodes.summary: Cell's Disaster!! The Destruction of His Perfect Form Gohan's Super Saiyan strength appears to have no limit, and the young hero delivers a blow so severe it causes Cell to cough up Android 18!

episodes.title: A Hero's Farewell
episodes.summary: Bye-Bye Everyone!! Goku's Last Instant Movement Clearly overmatched by Gohan, Cell initiates his last line of defense: a self-destruct program that will blow up the entire planet! With only seconds to spare, Goku risks everything to transport Cell away from the Earth.

episodes.title: Cell Returns!
episodes.summary: The Nightmare is Reborn!! An Absolute and Perfect Terror The nightmare continues! Cell explodes, but a particle of his nucleus survives the blast, providing all the android needs to regenerate himself! Restored to his ultimate form, Cell returns to the Earth more powerful than ever!

episodes.title: The Horror Won't End
episodes.summary: From Goku to Gohan… A Father's Spirit is Passed Down Vegeta lashed out against Cell but was incapacitated in a single blow. Gohan jumps in front to save Vegeta and is wounded in the process. Cell and Gohan unleash their devastating Kamehameha waves as they collide in a fierce beam struggle.

episodes.title: Save the World
episodes.summary: The Fight is Over… Thank You, Son Goku The final showdown begins! While Goku telepathically coaches Gohan from the Other World, the Z-Fighters jump in for a five-sided attack! Gohan has the potential inside him, but can Goku show him how to unlock it?

episodes.title: Goku's Decision
episodes.summary: I Will Carry On in the Afterlife!! Farewell with a Smile Cell is finally defeated, but the Z-Fighters still have much to resolve! Can they make it to the Lookout in time to heal the badly-injured Gohan? Is Android 18 still a threat? And can our heroes find a way to bring back Goku?

episodes.title: One More Wish
episodes.summary: A New Day Will Come… Father! I'll Hang in There With one more wish left, what shall the Z-Fighters wish for?

episodes.title: Free the Future
episodes.summary: Peace and order have been restored on Earth in the present, but Trunks' future world is still a place of darkness and despair! Once he arrives home, the future will be forever changed!

episodes.title: Warriors of the Dead
episodes.summary: When Goku hears about a martial arts master known as the Grand Kai, he rushes to meet him for a lesson! Meanwhile, Cell, Frieza, King Cold and the Ginyu Force have teamed up to take control of Other World!

episodes.title: Tournament Begins
episodes.summary: Goku must train for 10,000 years before he can study under the Grand Kai! But when the West, South, and East Kaiâ€ôs decide to hold an Other World Tournament, Goku gets his chance! All he has to do is defeat the greatest fighters of all time!

episodes.title: Water Fight
episodes.summary: The Other World Tournament advances to the Quarter-Finals, and the battles are out of this world! Goku's opponent, Arqua, appears to be a wimp, but things change quickly when he transforms the entire ring into water!

episodes.title: Final Round
episodes.summary: Goku advances to the final round of the tournament where he will face the warrior Pikkon! Sparks of energy fly as the brawlers battle for the title! When Pikkon reveals a Piccolo-like secret, Goku must up the ante! It's Super Saiyan time!

episodes.title: Goku vs.Pikkon
episodes.summary: Goku may be a Super Saiyan, but can he withstand Pikkon's unbelievable Thunder Flash Attack?! And that's not all! While Goku's been fighting in Other World, seven years have passed on Earth, Gohan is now a teenager!

episodes.title: Gohan Goes to High School
episodes.summary: 7 Years Since That Event! Starting Today, I'm a High Schooler On his first day of high school, Gohan stops a truckload of bank robbers by turning Super Saiyan. Now, the city can't stop talking about this mysterious "Gold Fighter!" Can Gohan get through class without revealing his secret identity?

episodes.title: I am Saiyaman!
episodes.summary: The Champion and Lover of Justice — The Great Saiyaman Appears Afraid he will be recognized by his classmates, Gohan gets Bulma to design a retractable super-hero costume that he can activate in an instant. Say goodbye to Gohan - and hello to Saiyaman.

episodes.title: Gohan's First Date
episodes.summary: Gohan's Confusing First Date?! Gohan thinks being a super-hero is a snap until a pretty girl named Angela discovers his secret. When Angela threatens to tell all unless he goes on a date with her, Gohan's life suddenly becomes more complicated than ever!

episodes.title: Rescue Videl
episodes.summary: Gohan, Get Moving Quick! Rescue Videl!! When the Red Shark Gang kidnaps the mayor and demands a showdown with Mr. Satan, it's Videl who answers the challenge. Gohan knows Videl is in over her head, but he can't leave his classroom to help her without blowing his cover!

episodes.title: Blackmail
episodes.summary: A Robbery Case!! The Culprit is Saiyaman?! When a greedy circus promoter kidnaps a baby dinosaur, all he sees are dollar signs! Little does he know, that the dinosaur is a close, personal friend of the Great Saiyaman!

episodes.title: I'll Fight Too
episodes.summary: Goku's Also Resurrected?! He's Participating in the Tenka'ichi Budōkai!! The Great Saiyaman is about to become a movie star but the hero's brush with stardom better not take long, because he has to hurry up and tell all of his old friends the big news: Goku is coming back.

episodes.title: The Newest Super Saiyan
episodes.summary: Even Gohan is Surprised! Goten's Explosion of Power While training for the upcoming tournament, Gohan discovers that Goten has already reached the level of Super Saiyan! Sparks fly when the brothers spar, but the main event happens when Videl meets Chichi for the first time!

episodes.title: Take Flight, Videl
episodes.summary: Ah, I Flew!! Videl's Introduction to Flight With the Tournament fast approaching, Videl and Goten must learn to fly! Miles away, Vegeta holds a training session of his own, and his young son, Trunks, has a big surprise in store for him

episodes.title: Gather for the Tournament
episodes.summary: Welcome Back, Goku! The Whole Z Team Assembles!! Videl learns to fly, and Gohan and Goten do some last minute honing of their Super Saiyan skills. On the island where the tournament will be held, a special guest arrives! What do you say to a hero who's been dead for seven years?!

episodes.title: Camera Shy
episodes.summary: You're in Danger, Saiyaman! Guard Yourself Against a Perfectly Timed Photo?! Everyone qualifies for the World Tournament.

episodes.title: The World Tournament
episodes.summary: No Small Matter!! Little Trunks The action begins as the World Martial Arts Tournament opens with the Junior Division! Thirty-five young fighters vie for the prize, but the matches prove to be more comedy than competition - until Trunks steps into the ring!

episodes.title: Trunks vs. Goten
episodes.summary: It's My Turn!! Goten's Anxious First Fight Goten and Trunks breeze through the Junior Division of the tournament until they find themselves going head-to-head in the finals! Who will win this exciting match? This is one championship fight you won't want to miss!

episodes.title: Best of the Boys
episodes.summary: Happiness Times a Million! The Junior Champion is Decided!! The match for the Junior Division World Championship continues as Goten and Trunks battle for the title! The winner of this final joust becomes the new World Champion! Can Goten outwit the cunning Trunks?

episodes.title: Big Trouble, Little Trunks
episodes.summary: Now What, Satan?! The Greatest Pinch in History After winning the championship, Trunks fights an exhibition match against Mr. Satan! Can the Champ hold on to his reputation as the world's strongest fighter? Meanwhile, two mysterious figures reveal themselves to Goku!

episodes.title: Who Will Fight Who?
episodes.summary: The Match-Ups Are Decided!! Hurry and Hold the First Round Trunks and Gohan infiltrate the adult competition at the tournament by donning the disguise of Mighty Mask. The pairings for the day matches are selected. The first to fight: Krillin vs. Pintar, a man easily ten times Krillins size!

episodes.title: Forfeit of Piccolo
episodes.summary: What's the Matter, Piccolo?! An Unheard-of No-Fight Forfeit Piccolo stuns the crowd by surrendering to his mysterious opponent before the first punch is thrown! Next into the ring is Videl, who must face the enormous Spopovitch. Will she be able to handle such a large job?

episodes.title: A Dark and Secret Power
episodes.summary: Undyingly Unpleasant?! The Mystery of Spopovitch Videl takes to the ring for what is expected to be an easy victory over Spopovitch. She hits the towering brute with everything shes got, but her attacks have no effect. It seems Spopovitch is possessed by a supernatural power!

episodes.title: Videl is Crushed
episodes.summary: A Tragic Videl!! Are You Coming Out, Angry Super Gohan? To everyones horror, Spopovitch delays his inevitable victory for the purposes of torturing Videl! It appears the muscle-bound thug isn't going to stop until he kills her! Will Videl make it out of the ring alive?

episodes.title: Identities Revealed
episodes.summary: Exposed!! The Saiyaman is Son Gohan Gohan's identity is finally discovered as he takes his place on the tournament floor, but he has bigger things to worry about. His opponent, Kibito, is determined to see him transform into a Super Saiyan!

episodes.title: Energy Drain
episodes.summary: A Slithering Conspiracy!! Gohan's Power is Stolen When Gohan transforms into a Super Saiyan, Spopovitch and Yamu spring into action! Armed with a mysterious energy-draining device, the pair launch an attack on the golden-haired teen.

episodes.title: The Wizard's Curse
episodes.summary: The Man Behind the Curtain Appears!! The Evil Mage Babidi The Z-Fighters race to stop Babidi's cronies from delivering the pure energy that will be used resurrect the dreaded Majin Buu. Will they find Babidis hidden spaceship in time?

episodes.title: King of the Demons
episodes.summary: The Awaiting Trap!! A Challenge From the Demon Realm Piccolo and Krillin are turned to stone by Dabura! Determined to save their friends, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta board Babidi's ship only to find themselves trapped! Can they save their friends and find their way out?

episodes.title: Vegeta Attacks
episodes.summary: Don't Toy With Me!! Vegeta Breaks Through the First Fight in a Fury At each stage of Babidi's ship, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta must face a fearsome warrior, each more powerful than the last. There's no room for error. Even the tiniest mistake will enable Babidi to steal their energy for Majin Buu.

episodes.title: Next Up, Goku
episodes.summary: Goku's Power Wide Open!! Blow Away Yakon Babidi unleashes his monster Yakon to steal the Z-Fighters' energy for Majin Buu. The battle at Stage Two is sure to be intense, as Yakon is one of the most fearsome creatures in the universe!

episodes.title: Battle Supreme
episodes.summary: A Great Miscalculation!! Satan vs Three Super Warriors?! At the World Martial Arts Tournament, the five remaining competitors enter the ring for an all-out Battle Royale! The fists fly as Number 18, Mighty Mask, and Mr. Satan duke it out to decide who will be the next Champion of the World!

episodes.title: Eighteen Unmasks
episodes.summary: Such Strong Kids!! No. 18's Close Fight?! The battle heats up as Number 18 and Mighty Mask take their fight to the skies. Number 18 gives it everything she's got, but her attacks prove useless against her masked opponent. Could she find the edge she needs to win?

episodes.title: Pay to Win
episodes.summary: A Confrontation With the Demon King! It's Your Turn Gohan!! As the final bout of the tournament continues, Number 18 throws the defending champ for a loop by offering to throw the fight! Meanwhile, Babidi has selected his warrior for Stage 3: Dabura, King of the Demon World!

episodes.title: Heart of a Villain
episodes.summary: A Wicked Heart is Discovered!! Dabura's Good Idea The intense battle between Gohan and Dabura rages on, but just as the Stage 3 clash reaches a heated peak, Dabura stops the fight! Why has the evil giant conceded, and what is the great discovery he claims to have made?

episodes.title: The Dark Prince Returns
episodes.summary: Vegeta, the Prince of Destruction, is Revived!! Intrusion at the Tournament In an all-out assault against Vegeta, Babidi uses his power to undo the unsuspecting Prince from within! Vegeta is stripped of his good qualities by the wicked wizard, and becomes the heartless warrior that he once was!

episodes.title: Vegeta's Pride
episodes.summary: A Super Confrontation of Destiny!! The Clash of Goku vs Vegeta Goku has no choice but to accept Vegeta's challenge.

episodes.title: The Long Awaited Fight
episodes.summary: Just You Wait, Babidi!! Your Aspirations Will Not be Allowed The battle between Goku and Vegeta has begun! With Babidi's magic enhancing his already incredible strength, Vegeta matches Goku move for move, but every blow the Saiyan Prince lands is a boost for Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Magic Ball of Buu
episodes.summary: The Seal is Broken! Out Comes the Vicious Majin Buu!! Gohan and the Supreme Kai confront Babidi in the depths of his space ship. With the fight between Goku and Vegeta supplying vast quantities of energy for Majin Buu, with not a moment to lose.

episodes.title: Buu is Hatched
episodes.summary: I Won't Allow the Revival!! A Kamehameha of Resistance The seal encasing Buu is finally broken! Supreme Kai insists on retreat, but Gohan refuses, launching an incredible series of energy attacks. When the shell opens, nothing is inside! Gohan, however, there is no time to celebrate..

episodes.title: The Losses Begin
episodes.summary: A Straight Line to Despair?! The Grief of Kaiōshin With his big pink belly and infantile behavior, Buu doesn't fit the bill of a galaxy destroyer - until he hurls Dabura into a cliff with a single blow! Gohan senses a limitless power, and the Supreme Kai insists this is the end!

episodes.title: The Terror of Majin Buu
episodes.summary: Supreme Kai must use his unique fighting powers to keep Buu at bay - or lose his life! One mile away, Goten and Trunks stumble upon Piccolo, still frozen in stone, and accidentally shatter him to pieces! And there's more! The King of Demons returns!

episodes.title: Meal Time
episodes.summary: Free from the grip of Babidi, Vegeta decides to seek his revenge by destroying the monster Majin Buu. Assuming Gohan to be a victim of the voracious villain, the Super Saiyan goes ballistic. Can Vegeta bring down Buu?

episodes.title: The Warrior's Decision
episodes.summary: A Warrior's Resolution!! I Will Dispose of the Majin The battle between Prince of Destruction Vegeta and Buu has begun! Vegeta is forced into a tough fight like never before as Buu shows no signs of taking any damage even after a hole is pierced in his stomach. Just as Vegeta is in a pinch due to Buu's unconventional strategy of wrapping his own torn body around his opponent and attacking him, Trunks steps in, unable to bear the sight!

episodes.title: Final Atonement
episodes.summary: For Those Whom He Loves… Vegeta Perishes!! After fighting with Majin Buu, Vegeta realizes he isn't fighting for just himself, but for the entire planet, and commits the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Evil Lives On
episodes.summary: The Nightmare Revisited! Majin Buu has Survived Majin Buu's flesh is scattered on the battlefield, but his mystical power is rebuilding the monster into one deadly piece. Babidi is recovering, too, having narrowly survived Piccolo's attack.

episodes.title: Find the Dragonballs
episodes.summary: The Struggle of Videl and the Others! Find the Dragon Balls Videl, Yamcha, Master Roshi, Chi Chi and Bulma find the last Dragon Ball... then it gets eaten by a dinosaur.

episodes.title: Revival
episodes.summary: Enormous Hope!! A New Finishing Technique for the Little Squirts Goku hatches a plan for defeating Majin Buu: Fusion! By joining two fighters of equal size and strength, an entirely new fighter can be created. But only one such pair remains-Goten and Trunks! Can the young half-Saiyans save the world?

episodes.title: Global Announcement
episodes.summary: Goten and Trunks — The World's Most Wanted Babidi seeks vengeance against Piccolo, Goten, and Trunks! Plastering images on everyone's mind, Babidi threatens to terrorize humanity until the trio is brought forward! Meanwhile, Gohan is taken to Supreme Kai's world!

episodes.title: Learn to Fuse!
episodes.summary: Gohan is Revived — Kaiōshin's Secret Weapon?! Goku begins training Goten and Trunks in the art of Fusion. Meanwhile, Gohan, having been healed in Supreme Kai's world, tries to remove the legendary Z-Sword to use in the fight against Majin Buu!

episodes.title: The Z Sword
episodes.summary: It Came Ou~t!! The Legendary Z Sword Majin Buu launches into a feeding frenzy, transforming an entire town's population into chocolate! Gohan draws the ancient Z-Sword, Goku struggles to teach Goten and Trunks the art of Fusion, and an unlikely hero is asked to join the fight!

episodes.title: Race to Capsule Corp.
episodes.summary: West City is Targeted! Stop, Majin Buu!! As Goten and Trunks train to stop the vicious Majin Buu, Idasa's jaded mother tells Babidi exactly where Trunks lives! The Z-Fighters must now find a way to stop the evil wizard before he reaches Capsule Corp!

episodes.title: Super Saiyan 3
episodes.summary: An Astounding, Great Transformation!! Super Saiyan 3 Trunks searches frantically for the lost dragon radar, and Goku powers-up to an unimaginable level: Super Saiyan 3! Will this newfound strength be enough to stop Majin Buu from destroying West City?

episodes.title: Buu's Mutiny
episodes.summary: Bye-Bye, Babidi!! Majin Buu Rebels Goku uses his new Super Saiyan 3 abilities to combat the evil Majin Buu, buying Trunks the time he needs to locate the missing Dragon Radar. But now that Goku has started the fight, he may not be able to escape!

episodes.title: The Fusion Dance
episodes.summary: Absurdly Awful Looking?! The Special Training Transformation Pose Liberated from his master, Majin Buu becomes even more destructive than before, wiping out entire cities in mere seconds! Earth's only hope now rests on the shoulders of two young warriors: Goten and Trunks!

episodes.title: Goku's Time Is Up
episodes.summary: See You Later, Everybody!! Goku Returns to the Afterlife Tensions rise for Goten and Trunks as their duel with Majin Buu approaches. Meanwhile, Buu prepares for the upcoming battle by building himself a home! Elsewhere, Goku bids a poignant farewell as he finally returns to Other World.

episodes.title: Return to Other World
episodes.summary: Where is Gohan?! Training in the Kaiōshin Realm While Trunks and Goten continue their quest to perfect the Fusion Technique, Gohan seeks to master the Z-Sword. Back on Earth, an encounter with a blind boy reveals that there is another side to the belligerent Buu!

episodes.title: Out from the Broken Sword
episodes.summary: You're Kidding, Right?! The Z Sword is Broken Gohan breaks the Z Sword in training, but from within it comes a new Kai, with a new technique!

episodes.title: Gotenks is Born
episodes.summary: The Birth of a Superhuman Warrior!! His Name is Gotenks After many comical misfires, Trunks and Goten finally perfect the Fusion technique, and Gotenks is born! Defying Piccolo's command, the super-kid immediately leaves to go fight Majin Buu! Is Gotenks ready for the fight of his young life?

episodes.title: Unlikely Friendship
episodes.summary: The Final Weapon is Engaged?! Satan Will Save the Earth As Majin Buu continues to terrorize humanity, a lone savior appears: Mr. Satan! But his Megaton punch won't be enough to stop the monster, but this unlikely hero may have a few surprises in store for Buu!

episodes.title: I Kill No More
episodes.summary: I've Stopped Killing!! Majin Buu's Good Boy Declaration While the Z-Fighters continue training in preparation for their battle with Majin Buu, Mr. Satan devises some sneakier plans to take the villain down. But will he even need to carry them out? Is Majin Buu having a change of heart?

episodes.title: The Evil of Men
episodes.summary: Run Away, Satan!! An Angry Majin Buu Emerges When Mr. Satan inspires Majin Buu to give up his evil ways, it seems the professional pretender has really saved the world. But when a deranged madman suddenly spoils Buu's good mood, the pink terror goes on another rampage.

episodes.title: Buu Against Buu
episodes.summary: Which One Will Win?! A Good and Evil Boo-Boo Confrontation Good Buu and Evil Buu begin fighting and it seems Evil Buu is much stronger. After a counterattack from Evil Buu the Good Buu turns into chocalate and the Evil Buu eats him and transforms into Super Buu.

episodes.title: Empty Planet
episodes.summary: A Catastrophe With No Time to Lose!! Earth's Humanity is Exterminated When the new and improved Majin Buu makes a surprise visit to the Lookout to challenge Gotenks, every second becomes a test of survival! And where are Trunks and Goten during the chaos that erupts?... Sound asleep, of course!

episodes.title: Time Struggle
episodes.summary: The Special Training is a Success!! You're Finished Now, Majin Buu Before he can unleash his fury on the remaining Z-Fighters, Majin Buu is coaxed into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber.
